compatibility: New optional fields/check IDs/codes may be added within v1. Consumers ignore unknown codes; changed type/status/meaning requires v2. This schema enumerates the currently emitted producer vocabulary.

connector.exit_codes: 0 produced report even with failed checks; existing application/usage/unavailable/uncertain exits unchanged

AUTHENTICATION_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the selected Server and existing identity through an explicit check.
AUTHENTICATION_UNCONFIRMED.reason: Available error metadata does not establish a specific authentication outcome.

AUTH_FAILED.next_action: Inspect the existing identity and current Server policy; no credential was replaced.
AUTH_FAILED.reason: The Server explicitly refused the selected participant authentication or scope.

BINARY_CANDIDATE_INVALID.next_action: Review the selected candidate and binding explicitly.
BINARY_CANDIDATE_INVALID.reason: Candidate validation refused the selected executable.

BINARY_CANDIDATE_VALIDATED.next_action: Review technical qualification and provider authentication separately.
BINARY_CANDIDATE_VALIDATED.reason: The explicitly selected candidate passed passive validation; no native version process or provider login was run.

BINARY_CHECK_NOT_REQUESTED.next_action: Use doctor --probe explicitly to validate the selected candidate.
BINARY_CHECK_NOT_REQUESTED.reason: The selected executable exists but candidate validation was not requested.

BINDING_NOT_CHECKED.next_action: Use status to inspect existing R4 connection progress; doctor does not create bindings.
BINDING_NOT_CHECKED.reason: Legacy binding metadata does not establish a current approved R4 connection.

CHECK_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the selected instance and rerun the same diagnostic; no repair was attempted.
CHECK_UNCONFIRMED.reason: A diagnostic observation could not be completed safely.

CONNECTOR_ID_ABSENT.next_action: Use connect explicitly when ready to configure this instance.
CONNECTOR_ID_ABSENT.reason: No Connector identifier was present in the returned snapshot.

CONNECTOR_ID_PRESENT.next_action: Verify Server authority separately; an identifier is metadata.
CONNECTOR_ID_PRESENT.reason: The returned snapshot contains a Connector identifier.

CONTAINMENT_PREFLIGHT_CONFIRMED.next_action: Productive launch and provider qualification remain separate checks.

CONTAINMENT_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the supported execution host; no process was launched to repair it.
CONTAINMENT_UNCONFIRMED.reason: Containment preflight could not establish current evidence.

CORE_CONTRACT_INVALID.next_action: Install the approved Connector and its exact pinned Core artifact.
CORE_CONTRACT_INVALID.reason: The executable R4 bundle is unavailable or invalid.

CORE_CONTRACT_VERIFIED.next_action: Review provider, binding, authorization and lease evidence separately.
CORE_CONTRACT_VERIFIED.reason: The executable R4 bundle passed its contract verification.

CORE_IMPORT_FAILED.next_action: Reinstall the approved Connector distribution and its pinned Core.
CORE_IMPORT_FAILED.reason: The installed Core could not be imported.

DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT.next_action: Inspect the existing snapshot without assuming it is empty or corrupt.
DIAGNOSTIC_LIMIT.reason: The bounded state observation could not read the complete snapshot.

EXECUTABLE_MISSING.next_action: Review discovery and the selected binding explicitly.
EXECUTABLE_MISSING.reason: The selected legacy binding executable was not found.

HANDOFF_TEST_NOT_OBSERVED.next_action: Inspect separately consented canonical handoff work.
HANDOFF_TEST_NOT_OBSERVED.reason: This host diagnostic did not inspect a correlated handoff claim and result.

IDENTITY_METADATA_PRESENT.next_action: Authenticate the selected identity separately; metadata does not prove credential validity.
IDENTITY_METADATA_PRESENT.reason: The returned snapshot contains imported identity metadata.

IDENTITY_NOT_SELECTED.next_action: Use connect or identity add explicitly when intended.
IDENTITY_NOT_SELECTED.reason: The returned snapshot has no imported identity selection.

INSTALLATION_CANDIDATES_PRESENT.next_action: Review selection, technical eligibility and provider login separately.

INSTALLATION_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the intended installation or select its executable explicitly.
INSTALLATION_UNCONFIRMED.reason: Passive discovery found no candidates in its supported search scope.

JOURNAL_NOT_OBSERVED.next_action: Inspect existing daemon state; do not infer productive history.
JOURNAL_NOT_OBSERVED.reason: The journal has not been created for this selection.

JOURNAL_SIZE_HIGH.next_action: Review the journal maintenance procedure before changing it.
JOURNAL_SIZE_HIGH.reason: The observed journal size exceeds the advisory threshold; this does not prove failed work or journal corruption.

JOURNAL_SIZE_OBSERVED.next_action: Inspect journal health separately if required.
JOURNAL_SIZE_OBSERVED.reason: The existing journal size was observed; journal contents and health were not tested.

JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: Inspect access to the existing journal; do not infer corruption.
JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The journal size could not be read.

LEGACY_CONTRACT_REPORTED.next_action: Use the executable contract check for current R4 compatibility.
LEGACY_CONTRACT_REPORTED.reason: The Core reports its legacy contract revision.

MCP_NEGOTIATION_NOT_OBSERVED.next_action: Inspect the intended authenticated MCP client separately.
MCP_NEGOTIATION_NOT_OBSERVED.reason: This host diagnostic did not observe MCP negotiation.

PARTICIPANT_AUTHENTICATED.next_action: Review authorization, provider login and productive work separately.
PARTICIPANT_AUTHENTICATED.reason: The current response matches the selected Server and participant identity.

PARTICIPANT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.next_action: Use an explicit check with the existing selected identity.
PARTICIPANT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.reason: This check did not establish authentication of the selected participant.

PARTICIPATION_NOT_OBSERVED.next_action: Run a separately consented coordination check when intended.
PARTICIPATION_NOT_OBSERVED.reason: This host diagnostic did not observe a correlated participant exchange.

PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: Inspect the host containment prerequisites before requesting managed work.
PROCESS_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The supported host lacks a required containment capability.

PROVIDER_LOGIN_NOT_CHECKED.next_action: Complete provider login explicitly on the execution host when required.
PROVIDER_LOGIN_NOT_CHECKED.reason: No provider login was tested by this diagnostic.

PYTHON_SUPPORTED.reason: The Python runtime satisfies the supported minimum.

PYTHON_UNSUPPORTED.reason: The Python runtime is below the supported minimum.

RUNTIME_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the selected connection and current Server authorization.
RUNTIME_UNCONFIRMED.reason: This host inspection does not establish canonical admission to execute work.

SCOPE_MISMATCH.next_action: Review the existing identity selection before explicitly replacing a credential.
SCOPE_MISMATCH.reason: The returned agent differs from the selected participant identity.

SERVER_CHECK_NOT_REQUESTED.next_action: Use doctor --probe explicitly for the existing selected Server and credential.
SERVER_CHECK_NOT_REQUESTED.reason: No active Server check was requested.

SERVER_ID_CONFIRMED.next_action: Verify the participant identity and runtime authorization independently.
SERVER_ID_CONFIRMED.reason: The returned Server identity matches the saved selection.

SERVER_ID_MISMATCH.next_action: Review the selected Server installation explicitly; no profile was changed.
SERVER_ID_MISMATCH.reason: The returned Server identity differs from the saved selection.

SERVER_ID_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Use an explicit check against the saved Server selection.
SERVER_ID_UNCONFIRMED.reason: The current Server installation identity was not verified.

SERVER_RESPONSE_CONFIRMED.next_action: Review the separate Server identity and participant authentication checks.
SERVER_RESPONSE_CONFIRMED.reason: The selected endpoint returned a current Server response.

SERVER_RESPONSE_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the selected origin and repeat the explicit check if intended.
SERVER_RESPONSE_UNCONFIRMED.reason: A current response from the selected Server was not established.

SERVER_UNREACHABLE.next_action: Inspect the selected origin and network; missing evidence does not prove authentication failure.
SERVER_UNREACHABLE.reason: The check did not establish a usable current Server response.

SERVER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.next_action: Inspect the Server and Connector versions; authentication remains independent.
SERVER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.reason: The response is incompatible with the required Server management contract.

SERVICE_IPC_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect the existing daemon without assuming work is absent.
SERVICE_IPC_UNCONFIRMED.reason: The additional daemon status request could not be observed.

SERVICE_NOT_READY.next_action: Start or repair this selected instance explicitly when intended.
SERVICE_NOT_READY.reason: The selected instance is confirmed stopped or failed.

SERVICE_READY.next_action: Review the remote transport and productive-work evidence separately.
SERVICE_READY.reason: The existing selected instance answered its identity-bound IPC readiness check.

SERVICE_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect daemon status and logs before changing its lifecycle.
SERVICE_UNCONFIRMED.reason: The selected instance readiness is unconfirmed; it is not proven stopped.

STATE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT.next_action: Run connect explicitly when ready to configure this instance.
STATE_DIRECTORY_ABSENT.reason: The selected state directory is absent.

STATE_DIRECTORY_PRESENT.next_action: Inspect the independent state and daemon checks.
STATE_DIRECTORY_PRESENT.reason: The selected state directory exists; its contents are checked separately.

STATE_INVALID.next_action: Inspect or recover the selected snapshot explicitly; it was not changed.
STATE_INVALID.reason: The existing state snapshot cannot be decoded.

STATE_SCHEMA_COMPATIBLE.next_action: Inspect the independent state-directory and identity checks.
STATE_SCHEMA_COMPATIBLE.reason: The returned snapshot has a supported schema; it may be the in-memory default for an absent file.

STATE_UNAVAILABLE.next_action: Inspect access to the selected state directory.
STATE_UNAVAILABLE.reason: The state snapshot could not be read; its contents remain unknown.

STATE_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE.next_action: Use the compatible installed Connector; do not rewrite the snapshot through doctor.
STATE_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE.reason: The state snapshot uses an incompatible version.

TRANSPORT_NOT_OBSERVED.next_action: Inspect the existing daemon and selected Server.
TRANSPORT_NOT_OBSERVED.reason: No transport state was observed for the selected instance.

TRANSPORT_ONLINE.next_action: Verify participant authority, MCP participation and work results separately.
TRANSPORT_ONLINE.reason: The current daemon status reports an online transport.

TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect existing Server availability and reconnect progress.
TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED.reason: The daemon status did not establish an online transport.

UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.next_action: Use a supported executor with verified containment; do not disable containment.
UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.reason: The selected executor platform has no qualified containment backend.

VAULT_ACCESS_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Inspect access to the selected vault; no credential was repaired or replaced.
VAULT_ACCESS_UNCONFIRMED.reason: Existing vault access could not be established.

VAULT_BACKEND_DISCOVERED.reason: An OS vault backend name was discovered; credential access was not proved.

VAULT_ENUMERATION_UNCONFIRMED.next_action: Do not infer credential absence from an unavailable enumeration.
VAULT_ENUMERATION_UNCONFIRMED.reason: Vault namespace enumeration is unavailable or has no existing file.

VAULT_FALLBACK_APPROVED.next_action: Inspect credential availability separately; consent is not authentication.
VAULT_FALLBACK_APPROVED.reason: The existing restricted-file fallback consent is recorded.

VAULT_FALLBACK_NOT_APPROVED.next_action: Approve the fallback explicitly during identity import or configure an OS keyring.
VAULT_FALLBACK_NOT_APPROVED.reason: No OS backend was discovered and restricted-file fallback consent is absent.

VAULT_NAMESPACE_SNAPSHOT_READ.next_action: Authenticate the selected identity only through an explicit check.
VAULT_NAMESPACE_SNAPSHOT_READ.reason: The existing file-vault namespace count was read; credential validity was not tested.

VAULT_SNAPSHOT_INVALID.next_action: Inspect the existing vault format without replacing credentials implicitly.
VAULT_SNAPSHOT_INVALID.reason: The existing vault snapshot could not be interpreted.

WORK_NOT_CHECKED.next_action: Inspect the same existing work through its canonical receipt.
WORK_NOT_CHECKED.reason: This host diagnostic did not establish a canonical productive result.

nexus.exit_codes: 0 report without FAIL, 3 with FAIL, 2 usage, 130 interruption; legacy unchanged
nexus.service_failure_normalization: Only typed local_service FAIL plus state stopped/failed maps to SERVICE_NOT_READY in v1; legacy report is unchanged.

effects: Only actual existing facts; absent optional fields mean unreported, never false. Mode describes requested checks, not executed effects.

proof_statuses.FAIL: Current evidence refutes the named requirement or records its explicit refusal.
proof_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: The selected topology or role excludes the predicate; not unsupported or unobserved.
proof_statuses.PASS: Current evidence supports only the named predicate in its declared scope.
proof_statuses.UNKNOWN: Evidence was not requested, unavailable, bounded out or insufficient.

qualification: Declarative contract metadata; neither runtime evidence nor provider/service acceptance.
state_rules: Otherwise empty or any UNKNOWN -> incomplete
Otherwise checks_passed; never a global-ready assertion
text_policy: Codes, reason and next_action use controlled literals; arbitrary exception/server text is not copied. Evidence is key/type/enum bounded.
